title: HeartbeatRequest
description: Periodic worker heartbeat (protocols.md §6): presence mode, installed vs loaded models, current queue subscriptions, and rolling stats. Also the poll point for updates.

loaded.description: Warm right now — enables model-affinity routing.

digests.description: Optional artifact → content digest, where the model server exposes it. Ability is pinned to an artifact (ADR 15), so a changed digest means a NEW artifact whose score must be re-measured rather than inherited.

protocol_version.description: Queue-contract protocol version the worker speaks (skew gating, §7).

action_result.description: Outcome of the model-management action the previous heartbeat response issued. Closes the loop so the coordinator can mark the proposal applied or failed.

agent_version.description: The worker's build-stamped release version (semver-ish, e.g. 0.7.0). The coordinator judges FITNESS from this, not just protocol compatibility: a version can speak the contract correctly and still carry bugs that produce wrong results.
